name: Yamaha FJ1200
engine: 1188 cc air/oil-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: A tough air-cooled sport tourer. The rear suspension linkage and old brake calipers need the most attention.

add.title: Grease the rear suspension linkage
add.instructions: Strip the rear linkage, clean the bearings and bushings and grease them. Replace any that are seized or notchy.
add.reason: Owners call the linkage bearings the FJ's weak spot. They can seize if left dry.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Suspension linkage
known.what: The rear suspension linkage bearings can seize. Owners re-grease them regularly.
